newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Western Australia poised to win.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Western Australia poised to win.

text.p: Damien Martyn and Tom Moody put Western Australia in a strong position at tea on the final day of the Sheffield Shield match against South Australia on Monday.
Martyn and Moody took Western Australia to 190 for three at tea, 95 runs short of their victory target of 285. Martyn was on 43 and Moody 47.
In Hobart, New South Wales spin bowler David Freedman took two wickets to have Tasmania at 140 for three in pursuit of their winning target of 302.
Freedman had opener Jamie Cox stumped by Phil Emery for 67. He then had Michael DiVenuto leg before wicket for 25.
